caption:
Nvidia just approved the largest stock buyback in history. $235 billion. Here is what that number is telling every CEO right now. 📊

1) Lock compute contracts now. Nvidia earns $235B because hardware margins grow. Your next cloud AI contract costs more than today's.

2) Raise prices on AI work. AI is still specialized enough for Nvidia-level margins. Price yours before it isn't.

3) Hire AI builders now. The people building with Nvidia's chips are the most in-demand workers in tech. Wages follow.

4) Budget for a long run. Nvidia picked $235B in buybacks over more factories. AI demand is durable. Your 3-year plan holds.

5) The real number is $150B. The $235B is two programs. $85B already existed. They added $150B MORE just this week. That is the new conviction signal.

SAVE THIS: The $235B Floor.

Nvidia sitting on $235B in surplus cash while most companies are still deciding whether to use AI at all is the clearest sign you can get that this runs for years. The businesses reading it today lock in advantages that take three years to close.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Nvidia
